name: katazuku-shukatsu
description: Local-first, human-in-the-loop automation core for Japanese shukatsu (new-grad job hunting). SQLite single-writer data model, semantic layer, and a schema-driven settings UI.
author: kokotatan

scripts.check: npm run scan && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run cloudflare:check && npm run check:assets
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:application && npm run test:mobility && npm run test:agent-runtime && npm run test:decision-control && npm run test:platform && npm run test:migration && npm run test:write-layer && npm run test:api && npm run test:schema && npm run test:local-login && npm run test:google-workspace && npm run test:private-assets && npm run test:viewer && npm run test:cloudflare && npm run test:recording && npm run test:password-auth && npm run check:setup
scripts.cloudflare:check: npm run cloudflare:types && tsc -p cloudflare/tsconfig.json && wrangler deploy --config cloudflare/wrangler.example.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm pack --dry-run && node tools/check-npm-release.mjs
scripts.build:apps: npm --prefix board run build && npm --prefix status run build && npm --prefix inbox run build && npm --prefix insight run build && npm --prefix profile run build && npm --prefix people run build && npm --prefix prep run build && npm --prefix impact run build && node tools/assemble-apps.mjs
